### Added

- Add `platform` to `defineSite`: the hosted platform's address can live in `ginko.config.ts`, so `pnpm dev` reads the hosted content without an `.env` file, in every clone and worktree. `NUXT_PUBLIC_GINKO_PLATFORM` still overrides it, and `pnpm local:dev` sets it to the local platform. ([#84](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/84))

### Fixed

- Fix the Studio's long-form text editor (rich and page texts) opening as a small box: it now starts at about half the screen. ([#81](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/81))
